task: Real Windows LOCAL LLM origin and zero-egress falsification
overallReason: Positive leg impossible: no user-provided local model runtime exists (every scanner ABSENT) and the contract forbids silent installation/download, so 2 real local inferences cannot happen.

Isolation enforcement not demonstrated: non-admin cannot add firewall rules (netsh denied) and the AppContainer capability-less launcher path was rejected by UpdateProcThreadAttribute with ERROR_BAD_LENGTH on this build, so no OS-enforced zero-egress proof exists for a model process on this host.

Everything runnable without a model was run for real: the planner-seam hostile matrix (H1-H7) refused every hostile path with zero planner invocations and zero socket-level egress (positive controls prove the observation apparatus detects real traffic), H8 and the currentness-before-planner sub-item are recorded BLOCKED_NOT_RUNNABLE with precise causes, and the v0.1 R3 LOCAL fail-closed behavior was preserved (no source file modified).

subItems.seamReason: LOCAL PlannerPort origin cannot be independently attested by this runtime; caller-declared local provenance is not proof of no network egress — refusing execution until an enforceable trusted host is provided

subItems.reason: U01 requires a real, user-provided local model runtime to attack (swap its binary, feed it invalid currentness, replace its process). fact-collection.json records every scanner (tasklist process filter, where <exe> for ollama/llama-server/lmstudio/koboldcpp/gpt4all, 15 model directories, netstat listening ports 11434/8080/1234/7860/5000/1337/4891, docker images filter, HTTP probe of 127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags) returning ABSENT on this host, and the U01 contract forbids silent installation/download of models. With no model process there is nothing whose binary could be swapped or whose currentness could be invalidated; the case is recorded as not runnable rather than simulated.

subItems.conclusion: v0.1 has NO currentness gate ahead of the planner invocation: interpretGoalViaPlanner consumes no currentness record (C1 shows a planner call succeeding against an unattested registry). The real currentness gates sit (a) in deterministic resolveGoal (C2/C3, REGISTRY_CURRENTNESS_INSUFFICIENT) — a path with no model call at all — and (b) in authorization currentAuthority/authorizePlan/authorizeEffect, downstream of planning. Therefore "invalid currentness -> zero model calls" cannot be exercised against the planner path in v0.1; the planner-gate sub-item is BLOCKED_NOT_RUNNABLE, recorded without modifying any code.

launcherFailure.meaning: The failure is specific to the SECURITY_CAPABILITIES attribute on this Windows build (10.0.26300.9457) and this standard-user token, not to the attribute-list mechanics or PowerShell marshaling (pure C# reproduces it; cbSize sweep 24/28/32/40/48 all rejected). The capability-less AppContainer child therefore could NOT be launched via this P/Invoke path here. Recorded as mechanism ATTEMPTED / NOT DEMONSTRABLE — explicitly not evidence that AppContainer isolation is unavailable on Windows, only that this launcher path failed in this environment.
